Block Sites

You can set your Sky Hub to filter web pages.

There are two ways to filter websites using your Sky Hub. You can:

  • Block access to certain domain names (in the example www.bbc.co.uk the domain name is bbc.co.uk), or
  • Block sites that contains certain words in their URL (web address).

Once a block is set a user trying to access a blocked site will see a message saying that the site has been blocked by the Sky Hub Administrator.

To Enable Block Sites

  • Select Per Schedule to turn on Block Sites and block according to the settings on the Schedule page.
  • Select Always to turn on Block Sites and apply the block at all times.

Note: On the Schedule page you can set at what time of day the keyword and domain name blocking occurs.

To Allow Unrestricted Access To The Internet

  • Select Never.
  • Click Apply.

To Block Keywords or Internet Domains

  • Select when to turn on Keyword Blocking (Never, Per Schedule, or Always).
  • In the box where you see Type Keyword or Domain Name Here, type the Keyword or Domain Name you wish to block.
  • Click Add Keyword.
  • The Keyword or Domain Name will appear in the list below.
  • Continue adding Names and Keywords.
  • Select Apply when finished.

The list under the heading Block Sites Containing these Keywords or Domain Names contains the current list of Keywords or Domain Names to block.

To Delete A Keyword or Domain Name

  • Select the Keyword or Domain Name in the list.
  • Click Delete Keyword.
  • Continue selecting and deleting Names and Keywords until you are finished.
  • Select Apply.

To Delete All Keywords and Domain Names

  • Click Clear List.
  • Select Apply.

To Allow One Device To Have Unrestricted Access To The Internet

  • Select the Allow Trusted IP Address To Visit Blocked Sites check box.
  • Trusted IPv4 Address - Type the IP address of the device you wish to be exempt from the blocks in the Trusted IP Address area. You should only type numbers in the IP Address boxes.
  • Trusted IPv6 Address - Type the IP address of the device you wish to be exempt from the blocks in the Trusted IP Address area.
  • Select Apply.
